_comment: The one place Hypurr's plans are configured. The host serves this to the apps (method `pricing`) and the website copies it at build time. Prices are in rupees; null means not decided yet. Change numbers here only.
gstNote: Prices exclude GST. GST rate and GSTIN: to be confirmed before launch.

features: Hypurr Free on your own free account

payments._comment: Android: RevenueCat over Google Play Billing (app user id = gateway subject id). Web later: Razorpay. Stripe is off (PAYMENTS_STRIPE=1 on the Worker turns its old routes back on).

creditPacks._comment: Hypurr credits, sold as Google Play consumables via RevenueCat. productId must match the Play Console product and RevenueCat. creditsCents is what the gateway grants (USD cents of model usage, after Google's 15% and 18% GST). A message is one task turn sent from the phone; there is no shared free allowance (free use is on the user's own account), so Hypurr models on the gateway are paid from credits. approxMessages assumes ~0.5¢ per message on Hypurr Free (an agent turn of ~20-40k tokens); bigger tasks or Hypurr Pro use more.

freeAllowanceNote: No shared free allowance on Hypurr's key. Free use runs on each user's own account (Start free with your own account); the gateway is credits only.
